blocker.detail: the documentation rewrite runs a full inline review per name; the five names this node attempted cost USD 0.39 each on average, which projects the 485-name population to about USD 189, past this node's USD 60 ceiling. The brief's stop rule fires before the average-over-twenty ceiling test can be reached. Delivered: the rebuilt manifest and the measured rate; the remaining 480 names wait on a ceiling decision.

after.description: Number density of a specified neutral species averaged over the plasma volume enclosed by the last closed flux surface during plasma initiation. The population counts particles of that species only while electrically neutral, aggregated over internal states and velocity populations; ions of all positive charge states are excluded.
after.documentation:
Number density of neutral species. The volume average of the local [neutral species density](name:neutral_species_density) is defined by

$$
\langle n_s\rangle_V = \frac{1}{V}\int_V n_s\,dV
$$

after.description: Volume-averaged oxygen density is the spatial mean of the local oxygen number density, summed over all charge states from neutral O0 through fully stripped O8+, over the confined plasma volume inside the last closed flux surface.
after.documentation:
The volume-averaged oxygen density is the volume mean of the local oxygen number density—summed over all charge states from neutral O$^0$ through fully stripped O$^{8+}$—within the confined plasma volume bounded by the last closed flux surface. after.description: Volume-averaged dominant-state charge number for one specified ion species or lumped-ion population over the confined plasma volume.
after.documentation:
At each position, this quantity refers to the charge number of the dominant ionization state for one specified ion species or lumped-ion population, spatially averaged over the confined plasma volume.

after.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal current density is the total conventional current-density component in the toroidal direction assigned to a closed magnetic flux surface. It is the flux-surface average of the local toroidal component divided by major radius, normalized by the flux-surface average of inverse major radius.
after.documentation:
Flux-surface-averaged toroidal current density is the total conventional current-density component in the toroidal direction assigned to a closed magnetic flux surface. Its geometric weighting is the flux-surface average of the local toroidal component divided by major radius, normalized by the flux-surface average of inverse major radius.

$$\langle f\rangle = \oint f\,dS/|\nabla\psi| \,/\, \oint dS/|\nabla\psi|$$

censuses_after.method: the project census scripts read the live dump and report species families of >=3 members with domain splits and description-template variants; the re-read script (bulk_census.py) counts species families of >=3 members with divergent documentation text. The two family counts differ in method: 24 is the census script's species-token grouping, 16 is the re-read's stricter family test.
